Bug_Title: Consumed Stream pipelines should not be reused
Bug_Explanation: The bug is demonstrated by trying to reuse the stream 'pipeline' after it has been consumed by the findAny() operation. This will result in an IllegalStateException at runtime.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug() method calls the showBug() method from the BuggyStreamReuse class. This method attempts to reuse the stream 'pipeline' after it has been consumed by the findAny() operation. This results in an IllegalStateException, which causes the test case to fail.
